'''Ichikishima Shrine''' (市杵島神社) or '''Ichikishima-hime Shrine''' (市杵島姫神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}}

dedicated to {{ill|Ichikishima-hime|ja|市杵島姫神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ichikishima-hime||1=Ichikishima-hime|2=fr|3=Ichikishimahime|4=ja|5=イチキシマヒメ|6=zh|7=市寸島比賣命|8=ru|9=Итикишима-химэ|10=de|11=Ichikishima-hime}}, one of the {{ill|Munakata Three Goddesses|ja|宗像三女神|1=Three Munakata Goddesses|1=Three Munakata Goddesses|qq=Three Munakata Goddesses|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Munakata Three Goddesses|13=User:Immanuelle/Three Munakata Goddesses}}. Due to the syncretism of {{ill|Buddhism|en|Buddhism|qid=Q748|lt=Buddhism|1=Buddhism}} and [[Shinto]] ({{ill|Shinbutsu-shūgō|en|Shinbutsu-shūgō|qid=Q2279088|lt=Shinbutsu-shūgō|1=Shinbutsu-shūgō}}), Ichikishima-hime is often associated with the Buddhist deity [[Benzaiten]], and many shrines dedicated to her are colloquially referred to as Benten (弁才天, 弁財天, or 弁天). She is also frequently enshrined as a subsidiary deity within the precincts of temples and shrines.

According to the myth associated with the descent of the heavenly grandson ({{ill|Tenson kōrin|en|Tenson kōrin|qid=Q1084733|lt=Tenson Kōrin|1=Tenson kōrin}}), the three goddesses safeguarded Ninigi-no-Mikoto, leading to their veneration as protectors of children and their dedication in child-related shrines.
